references.quote: UCDP Battle-Related Deaths Dataset version 26.1 This file contains a dyad-year dataset with information on the number of battle-related deaths in the conflicts from 1989-2023 that appear in the UCDP/PRIO Armed Conflict Dataset. Available at dyadic level as: https://ucdp.uu.se/downloads/brd/ucdp-brd-dyadic-261-csv.zip CSV https://ucdp.uu.se/downloads/brd/ucdp-brd-dyadic-261-xlsx.zip Excel https://ucdp.uu.se/downloads/brd/ucdp-brd-codebook-261.pdf Codebook Available at conflict level as: https://ucdp.uu.se/downloads/brd/ucdp-brd-conf-261-csv.zip CSV https://ucdp.uu.se/downloads/brd/ucdp-brd-conf-261-xlsx.zip Excel https://ucdp.uu.se/downloads/brd/ucdp-brd-codebook-261.pdf Codebook https://ucdp.uu.se/downloads/brd/versionhistory-brd-261.pdf Version history Please cite • Shawn Davies, Therése Pettersson, Magnus Öberg, Organized violence 1989-2025, and violent political protests, Journal of Peace Research, 2026. https://doi.org/10.1093/jopres/xjag046 https://doi.org/10.1093/jopres/xjag046 • UCDP is part of and funded by DEMSCORE, national research infrastructure grant 2021-00162 from the Swedish Research Council.
